sloka: येनेदमीदृशं प्राप्तं दुःखं शोकसमन्वितम् ।न त्वया भरते वाच्यं शत्रुघ्नस्यापि सन्निधौ ।। ७.५०.१९ ॥
transliteration: yenedamīdṛśaṁ prāptaṁ duḥkhaṁ śokasamanvitam ।na tvayā bharate vācyaṁ śatrughnasyāpi sannidhau ।। 7.50.19 ॥

translations.english: This sorrow, accompanied by grief, which has been experienced, should not be spoken of by you to Bharata, nor even in the presence of Shatrughna.
